description: Enedis Distribution Grid Open Data is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Distribution network datasets > Enedis Distribution Grid Open Data", published or maintained by data.enedis.fr (publisher inferred from the link). Power grid data (low and medium voltage, up to 50 kV) from Enedis, the largest DSO in France (covers 95 % of all distribution grids). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Distribution network datasets" lists it under "Enedis Distribution Grid Open Data". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity distribution network inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
